rachel (pm): Quick thread: Customer Q asked for deterministic semantics when running multiple tool calls in parallel. They need clear commit rules, retries, and streaming markers. Can we propose a tight MVP?

diego (eng): Framing: two axes 1) ordering (none, sequenced) 2) commit semantics (atomic, independent, sequenced-commit).

anya (eng-ml): Suggest API knobs: mode: {parallel, sequenced_parallel}, commit_mode: {commit_all, commit_independent, commit_sequenced}, partial_policy: {drop_on_fail, deliver_with_flag}. Keep retries at per-step with chain-level retry_budget.

sophie (ux): SDKs should stream events: step.requested, step.response, step.committed, chain.final. Include step_id and commit_state so apps can patch doc progressively.

diego (eng): Implementation note: sequenced_parallel = fan-out + server-side buffer + ordered commit pass. Risks: head-of-line blocking + memory buffers. Add per-route max_fanout and buffer_limit.

anya (eng-ml): Response shape idea (non-streaming): {commit_status, step_statuses[], ordered_results[], warnings[]}. Expose attempts and latency for each step.

rachel (pm): MVP acceptance list: spec + samples (JS/Python), unit + e2e tests for commit modes, observability (per-step latency, retries, buffer depth), pilot w/ customer.

diego (eng): Metrics: step.latency_ms (hist), chain.retries, chain.commit_latency_ms, chain.partial_count, hol_block_events. Console per-route dashboards.

canary-bot (ops-bot): Canary plan: canary 3% -> 20% -> 100%. Auto-rollback if chain_abort_rate > 1.5% or memory_pressure > 75% on nodes.

sophie (ux): Docs: add decision table mapping commit_mode -> latency/cost/consistency tradeoffs and a small streaming snippet.

rachel (pm): Agreed. Next: Diego drafts RFC + perf prototype, Anya adds metric schemas, Sophie drafts doc snippets, ops will script canary. Target RFC review Wed. Thanks! :raised_hands:
